Subject: Post-discovery: lock 30-min orientation — three proposed windows & prep asks

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks again for your time yesterday — great conversation and good clarity around the ingestion and compliance questions. Per our notes, the best next step is a short 30‑minute orientation where we:

- Walk through a lightweight product demo focused on your telemetry ingestion flow
- Validate security/PII handling for the ETL pipeline (KMS + retention settings)
- Identify a quick success metric for a pilot (latency and cost targets)

Can you pick one of these three windows for the 30‑minute session? We’ll keep it tight and leave time for a couple quick follow-ups. All times listed in PT: 

Option A — Tue Dec 9 — 09:00–09:30 PT
Option B — Wed Dec 10 — 12:00–12:30 PT
Option C — Thu Dec 11 — 16:00–16:30 PT

Prep asks: if you can share the brief sample schema for the telemetry payload (or the S3 path) and confirm whether you want us to include a short security slide in the demo, we’ll tailor the run. I attached a 1‑page demo outline and the discovery notes from our call.

If none of those work, tell us two time bands that do and we’ll adapt. I’m copying Marissa (Solutions) to help lock the calendar and Karthik (infra PM) to answer any architecture questions in the session.

Thanks —
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0124
